summary: Checked the 28 Oct data audit and reviewed the generator and dashboard data code. Fixed the Overview's 7-day totals, which counted 8 days.
why: The audit's one error (v-20261023-01 views 1,175 → 1,166) is YouTube removing views: its Analytics fell from 1,175 to 1,164 and its counter reads 1,166, what the dashboard shows. dsh-006 was an open data bug with a small, testable fix.

findings.title: v-20261023-01 'went down' is a YouTube correction
findings.detail: Analytics rewritten 1,175 → 1,164, YouTube counter 1,166 = dashboard. The audit rule flags every such correction as an error; explained in an owner notification.

findings.title: Three long videos still unlisted on YouTube
findings.detail: Fifth audit in a row; owner setting, notification kept.

changes.title: Overview 7-day totals cover 7 days
changes.detail: windowStart(today, 7) in lib/totals.ts (today-6 to today, same as the week-over-week chart); test dashboard-window.test.ts.
